interview.name: Nell
interview.answer: The repair drive is being held soon, but the location is not specified in the notes.

reflections: Nell is trying to get oriented and prefers concrete details before acting.
Ira is the most proactive person here, taking responsibility to gather the full volunteer needs.
Oren and Nell are both aligned on the repair drive, but Oren is less certain and Nell is helping keep the conversation organized.
Nell is a consistently attentive, supportive coordinator who follows up for missing details and keeps others informed.
Several people are trying to confirm the repair drive’s status and needed supplies, which suggests the group is still aligning on the final plan.
Hana and Ira seem to be acting as information gatherers, with Hana waiting on the final list and Ira planning to ask for it directly.
Nell is trying to stay informed and is willing to help spread updates once details are confirmed.
Gus and Bo are coordinating the repair drive by clarifying needs and recruiting support.
The group is still in a waiting phase, with Hana checking the final list before sharing concrete information.
Nell is helpful and responsive, but she often notes she is still catching up and needs the latest details.
Gus relies on Nell to help spread repair-drive requests and seems appreciative of her support.
The group is coordinating practical repair-drive needs: volunteers, spare tools, repair skills, and small fixes.
Nell is consistently helpful and proactive, especially around community repair efforts and getting the word out.
Gus appears appreciative and relies on Nell's outreach support for the repair drive.
Eli and Nell coordinate logistics around timing and sharing details, with Nell balancing participation around school pickup and drop-off.

events.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still catching up on the details. Have you heard what they need help with?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Ira: I’ve only heard a little so far, but I think they’re looking for volunteers, tools, and maybe some spare parts. I’m planning to stop by and ask for the full list.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon — is that the one you meant?
events.speaker: Nell

events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the date and details. If you hear anything else, let me know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: Oh, that’s helpful — I’m still catching up, so I’d love to hear the full list too.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Kira: Yep, it’s still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I plan around it.

events.text: Nell: Yes, that’s what I heard too — it should still be happening soon, but I’m still waiting on the full details.

events.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still catching up too — have you heard whether they need volunteers, tools, or spare parts?

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — if you can, please spread the word that we still need volunteers, spare tools, and folks with repair skills, and have people bring any small fixes along too.

events.text: Nell: Sure, I can spread the word — volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, plus any small fixes. I’m still getting caught up, so that’s really helpful.

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate it. That’ll help the repair drive a lot.

events.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word about volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, and tell folks to bring any small fixes too.

events.text: Nell: Glad to help — I’ll pass it along and see who can pitch in.

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules — I’ll share the time and place as soon as they’re set. Appreciate you helping keep everyone in the loop.

events.text: Nell: Sounds good—just send me the final time, and I’ll fit it around school pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word, Gus — volunteers, spare tools, and anyone handy with repairs. I’ll also tell folks to bring any small fixes along.

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate it. That’ll help the repair drive a lot.

events.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and bring a couple broken items to fix. Just send me the time once it’s locked in, and I’ll pass it along.
